The '''Tenth Alsakan Conflict''' was one of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of civil wars that pitted the influential [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Occurring sometime after [[10,000 BBY]], the Tenth Conflict saw the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] make use of powerful [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] equipped with [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannons]]&mdash;planet-busting weapons developed from the technology of the [[Kumauri Empire]]. The Republic's tactic of [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] led to the event known as the [[Osara Mundicide]]. The Tenth Conflict ended in a draw sometime before the [[9400s BBY]], though tensions on both sides would continue to flare over the next seven thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tenth Alsakan Conflict was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', under the "Armory and Sensor Profile" entries for Planetary Defenses and Capital Ships.<ref name="Warfare" />
